questions.question: When King David asked the LORD why there was a three-year famine, what reason did the LORD give?

answers.text: Blood Saul shed killing the Gibeonites
Idols the people set up in the land

questions.question: To make amends for Saul's attack on them, what did the Gibeonites ask King David to hand over?

answers.text: Half of the land Saul held

questions.question: After seven of Saul's descendants were hanged, what did Saul's concubine Rizpah keep away from their bodies day and night?

answers.text: Birds by day and beasts by night
Thieves by day and strangers by night
Soldiers by day and mourners by night

questions.question: After the people did everything King David commanded about Saul's family and the Gibeonites, what happened?

answers.text: God answered prayers for the land
The Gibeonites moved away from Israel
